hec.io

Class AsciiDBFDataStorage

  • java.lang.Object
    • hec.io.AbstractDataStorage
      • hec.io.AsciiDBFDataStorage
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    DataStorage, FileListener

    public class AsciiDBFDataStorage
extends AbstractDataStorage
implements FileListener
    This Class implements both the Ascii Serializer methods and the DBF Storage methods. It takes a data object and serializes it into a String and the stores the objects id,name,description,and ascii serialized version into a DBF record
